idgam_meal_gunne.title: Idgham Ma'al Ghunnah
idgam_meal_gunne.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by one of the letters (ي م ن و), they are merged with a nasal sound.

0.explanation: Noon meets Ya, so Idgham occurs.

1.explanation: Noon meets Meem, so Idgham occurs.

idgam-bila-gunne.title: Idgham Bila Ghunnah
idgam-bila-gunne.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by Lam (ل) or Ra (ر), they are merged without a nasal sound.

0.explanation: Noon meets Ra, so Idgham without Ghunnah occurs.

1.explanation: Tanween meets Lam, so Idgham without Ghunnah occurs.

ihfa.title: Ikhfa
ihfa.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by an Ikhfa letter, the Noon sound is concealed with a nasal sound.

0.explanation: Sakin Noon meets Za, so Ikhfa occurs.

1.explanation: Sakin Noon meets Shin, so Ikhfa occurs.

izhar.title: Izhar
izhar.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by a throat letter, the Noon sound is pronounced clearly.

0.explanation: Sakin Noon meets Kha, so Izhar occurs.

1.explanation: Tanween meets Alif, so Izhar occurs.

iklab.title: Iqlab
iklab.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by Ba (ب), the Noon sound changes to Meem (م) with a nasal sound.

0.explanation: Sakin Noon meets Ba, so it converts to Meem.

1.explanation: Tanween meets Ba, so it converts to Meem.

kalkale.title: Qalqalah
kalkale.rule: When Qalqalah letters (ق ط ب ج د) are Sakin (have Sukoon), they are pronounced with an echoing sound.

0.explanation: Qaf is Sakin, so Qalqalah occurs.

1.explanation: Dal is Sakin, so Qalqalah occurs.

med_tabii.title: Natural Madd
med_tabii.desc: Elongation of a vowel letter for 2 counts naturally
med_tabii.rule: When a madd letter (alif, waw, ya) appears without a hamza or sukoon after it, it is elongated for 2 counts.

0.explanation: The alif after ba is elongated naturally for 2 counts.

1.explanation: The ya after mim is elongated naturally for 2 counts.

ra_hukmu.title: Rules of Ra
ra_hukmu.desc: The letter Ra is pronounced with tafkhim (heavy) or tarqiq (light) based on its position
ra_hukmu.rule: Ra with fatha or dhamma is heavy (tafkhim). Ra with kasra is light (tarqiq). Ra with sukoon depends on the preceding vowel.

0.explanation: Ra with fatha is pronounced heavy (tafkhim).

med_muttasil.title: Connected Madd
med_muttasil.desc: When a madd letter is followed by hamza in the same word
med_muttasil.rule: When a madd letter is followed by hamza in the same word, it is elongated for 4-5 counts.

0.explanation: The alif before hamza in the same word is elongated for 4-5 counts.

tenvin.question: Tenvin nedir?
tenvin.answer:
Tenvin, kelimenin sonunda bulunan nun harfinin ses etkisidir. Uc cesidi vardir:
• Fethatan (ً): Ustun tenvin
• Kesretan (ٍ): Esre tenvin
• Dammetan (ٌ): Otre tenvin
Tenvin, kelimenin sonundaki nunun yazilmadan okunmasidir.

gunne.question: Gunneli okuyus nasil olur?
gunne.answer:
Gunne, nun ve mim harflerinin genizden okunmasidir. Iki hareke miktari tutulur.
• Idgam (mealgunne): Nun sakineden sonra ي، ن، م، و gelirse
• Ihfa: Nun sakineden sonra 15 harf gelirse (ت ث ج د ذ ز س ش ص ض ط ظ ف ق ك)
• Iklab: Nun sakineden sonra ب gelirse, mime donusur ve gunneli okunur.

kalkale.question: Kalkale harfleri hangileri?
kalkale.answer:
Kalkale harfleri 5 tanedir ve "قطب جد" kelimesiyle ezberlenir:
• ق (Kaf), ط (Ti), ب (Ba), ج (Cim), د (Dal)
Bu harfler sakin (cezimli) oldugunda, cikis noktasinda bir sicrama veya titresim yapilir.

med.question: Med harfleri nelerdir?
med.answer: Uzatma (Med) harfleri uctur: Elif (ا), Vav (و) ve Ya (ي). Bu harfler kendinden onceki harfi bir elif miktari (yaklasik 1-1.5 saniye) uzatir.

makhraj.question: Mahrec nedir?
makhraj.answer: Mahrec, harflerin agizdan cikis yeridir. Kuran okurken harflerin dogru mahreclerinden cikarilmasi anlamin bozulmamasi icin cok onemlidir.

ihfa.question: Ihfa nasil yapilir?
ihfa.answer: Ihfa, sozlukte gizlemek demektir. Sakin nun veya tenvinden sonra ihfa harfleri geldiginde, nun sesini genizden getirerek hafifce gizleyerek okumaktir.

sekte.question: Sekte nedir?
sekte.answer: Sekte, sesi bir an icin kesip nefes almadan beklemektir. Kuran-i Kerim'de 4 yerde sekte bulunur (Kehf, Yasin, Kiyame ve Mutaffifin surelerinde).

izhar.question: Izhar nedir?
izhar.answer: Izhar, acikca okumaktir. Sakin nun veya tenvinden sonra bogaz harfleri (ء ه ح خ ع غ) gelirse, nun sesi hic tutulmadan ve gizlenmeden oldugu gibi okunur.
